sources.snippet: Official implementation of our DATE 2026 paper: "STEP-LLM: Generating CAD STEP Models from Natural Language with Large Language Models" STEP-LLM fine-tunes compact LLMs (Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B) to generate valid ISO 10303-21 STEP files directly from natural language descriptions, with optional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for improved accuracy.
